name: GetCommunicationCoverage
read_consistency: one short LLD-01 read snapshot of folder config, forward checkpoint and historical segments
ordering: enabled folders by role INBOX,SENT,OTHER then display_name,source_folder_id; historical segments newest first inside folder projection

rules: coverage timestamps/positions never substitute for message chronology
